integrity: Mathematical conclusions are accompanied by a self-contained analytic proof and a finite-level independent recurrence checker. No claim of independent validation or publication is made.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to odd primes dividing the progression step and to unit initial denominator. The critical image center is given by a convergent p-adic construction, not a closed rational formula. Finite tests do not establish the all-depth result; historical priority is subject to inaccessible sources and general Morse-normal-form comparisons.
title: Exact odd-prime-adic square images of second reciprocal-progression symmetric sums
